Devotion in Sand: Sudarshan Patnaik Honours Lord Jagannath

Sudarshan Patnaik, a devotee of Lord Jagannath, has created intricate sand carvings to commemorate the Deva Snana Purnima festival. This tradition is an important part of the Puri temple's cultural heritage. The event marks the beginning of Lord Jagannath's divine journey and is celebrated by devotees across India.
